cohort: The study included 9,987 records of live births in Divinopolis, Minas Gerais state, Brazil, from 2008-2011.
finding: Prematurity was associated with cesarean delivery, having fewer than 7 prenatal care visits, and lower maternal age.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher likelihood of preterm birth (OR=1.73; 95%CI 1.48;2.04).
